---
title: "Spinorama REST API"
date: 2026-08-22
abstract: >
  Read speaker and headphone metadata, precomputed measurements, and validation
  results through the Spinorama REST API.
---

The public API is available at [api.spinorama.org](https://api.spinorama.org).
It is read-only for data access. Interactive OpenAPI documentation is available
at [api.spinorama.org/docs](https://api.spinorama.org/docs).

The examples below use the current `/v1` API prefix and URL-encode names that
contain spaces or punctuation.

## Speakers

### List brands and speakers

```text
GET /v1/brands
GET /v1/speakers
```

```{.shell}
curl https://api.spinorama.org/v1/brands
curl https://api.spinorama.org/v1/speakers
```

Both endpoints return sorted JSON arrays.

### Get speaker metadata

```text
GET /v1/speaker/{speaker_name}/metadata
```

```{.shell}
curl "https://api.spinorama.org/v1/speaker/Genelec%208341A/metadata"
```

The response contains the brand, model, type, shape, price, measurement
versions, and other metadata. A missing speaker returns an error response.

### List measurement versions

```text
GET /v1/speaker/{speaker_name}/versions
```

```{.shell}
curl "https://api.spinorama.org/v1/speaker/Genelec%208341A/versions"
```

The version values are the measurement keys in the speaker metadata, such as
`asr`, `vendor`, or `eac`. Use the returned value exactly in the next requests.

### List available measurements

```text
GET /v1/speaker/{speaker_name}/version/{speaker_version}/measurements
```

```{.shell}
curl "https://api.spinorama.org/v1/speaker/Genelec%208341A/version/asr/measurements"
```

The endpoint lists precomputed graph names for that speaker and version. The
available set depends on the source data and can include `CEA2034`, `On Axis`,
`Estimated In-Room Response`, reflection graphs, SPL graphs, contours, and
radar graphs.

### Download a measurement

```text
GET /v1/speaker/{speaker_name}/version/{speaker_version}/measurements/{measurement_name}
```

The `measurement_format` query parameter defaults to `json`. PNG, JPG, and WebP
are available when the corresponding graph exists:

```{.shell}
curl "https://api.spinorama.org/v1/speaker/Genelec%208341A/version/asr/measurements/CEA2034?measurement_format=json"
curl "https://api.spinorama.org/v1/speaker/Genelec%208341A/version/asr/measurements/CEA2034?measurement_format=png" \
  --output Genelec-8341A-CEA2034.png
```

The API also accepts names ending in `_unmelted` for the JSON representation
where that precomputed data exists. Use the list endpoint rather than assuming
that every graph is available for every version.

## Headphones

```text
GET /v1/headphones
GET /v1/headphone/brands
GET /v1/headphone/shapes
GET /v1/headphone/{headphone_name}/metadata
GET /v1/headphone/{headphone_name}/versions
GET /v1/headphone/{headphone_name}/frequency_response
```

The headphone list accepts optional filters:

- `brand`
- `shape`: `over-ear`, `on-ear`, or `in-ear`
- `recommendation`: `Yes` or `No`

```{.shell}
curl "https://api.spinorama.org/v1/headphones?shape=over-ear"
curl "https://api.spinorama.org/v1/headphone/Example%20Model/metadata"
curl "https://api.spinorama.org/v1/headphone/Example%20Model/frequency_response"
```

The frequency-response endpoint returns CSV and uses the headphone's default
measurement unless a `version` query parameter is supplied.

## Validate speaker metadata

```text
POST /v1/validate
Content-Type: application/json
```

Send a JSON object containing at least `brand` and `model`. The response
contains `valid`, a list of `messages`, and the normalized `speaker_name`.

```{.shell}
curl -X POST "https://api.spinorama.org/v1/validate" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"brand":"MyBrand","model":"MyModel","type":"passive","shape":"bookshelves"}'
```

Use this endpoint to catch schema problems before submitting metadata. It does
not write to the database.
